events.title: HARVEST-Vision: Second International Workshop on Applications of CV and HPC in Agriculture

events.title: PEARC26: Resilient Roots + Empowered Communities
events.description: An annual conference bringing together the research computing and data community to share practices, experiences, and innovations in advanced research computing.

events.title: AgWireless’26: Accelerating Concerted 6G, AgTech & Multi-Use Innovation
events.description: A multi-day event bringing together researchers, industry leaders, government representatives, and agricultural technology communities to advance 6G, AgTech, rural connectivity, and multi-use innovation through workshops, demonstrations, training, and collaborative discussions.

events.title: Farm Science Review 2026
events.description: Ohio State's annual agricultural event featuring emerging technologies, equipment exhibits, field demonstrations, research, and educational programs for farmers, researchers, students, and agricultural industry professionals.

events.title: Summit for AI Institutes Leadership (SAIL) 2026
events.description: The annual Summit for AI Institutes Leadership brings together researchers, staff, and leaders from the national AI Institutes to share research, build connections, discuss best practices, and explore opportunities for collaboration. The conference is organized by the NSF AI Institutes Virtual Organization.
